summary: Gauley Mountain lookout in Fayette County was moved in 2009 to Whittaker Station at Cass Scenic Railroad State Park, where it still stands.

facts.status_note: The original Fayette County tower is listed as gone. The tower now stands at Whittaker Station, Cass Scenic Railroad State Park, Pocahontas County.

staffing.status: section ranger headquartered at the tower

access.note: NHLR says the tower is accessible by train from Cass. No source found says whether climbing is allowed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says relocated in 2009. The Eastern lookouts page gives October 28, 2009 for installation at Cass. NHLR says October 2009. The dates agree. NHLR's Built field reads 2009 for the Whittaker record, which fits the reassembled tower rather than the original build, which no source gives.

sources.title: Whittaker Station Fire Tower
sources.publisher: National Historic Lookout Register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Original build date and designer not found. Blaw-Knox appears only as the tower type on the Eastern lookouts and NHLR pages; no source ties the original Gauley tower to that firm, so design is recorded as the name used in the sources. Photos on the NHLR record (July 2010 photo by Brian M. Powell; relocation and October 2009 restoration shots by Andy FitzGibbon) have no image URLs or licence data captured, so none are added. NHLR says the Whittaker tower is administered by the West Virginia Division of Natural Resources; agency is recorded as the Division of Forestry for the original tower. Climbing rules are undocumented, so no visit fields are set. The story now calls the 2013 source minutes, not a trip report.
